name: Star Number / Monotonic co-VC Dimension (affine)
details: The monotonic co-VC dimension is at most the star number plus one.
proof: For every subfamily $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal H$, the established affine hollow-star bound gives $\mathrm S(\mathcal G)\ge\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal G)-1$. Star Number is subfamily-monotonic, so $\mathrm S(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal G)-1$. Taking the maximum over $\mathcal G$ gives $\mathrm S(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal H)-1.
